title: Amortized Counterfactual Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.13724v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Counterfactual inference asks how an observed outcome might have differed under different circumstances, such as whether a patient would have recovered had they received a different treatment. Such questions arise whenever decisions depend on the outcomes of alternatives that were not observed. Answering counterfactual queries generally requires knowledge of the underlying causal structure, which is often unavailable in practice. A common approach is therefore to first estimate the causal graph from observational data and then perform counterfactual inference. However, errors in the estimated causal graph can propagate to downstream counterfactual predictions. To address this challenge, we introduce the Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP), an end-to-end approach that answers counterfactual queries directly from observational data without first estimating a causal graph. translated_title: 基于图神经网络的摊销式反事实预测
translated_abstract: 反事实推断研究观察到的结果在不同情形下可能有何不同，例如患者如果接受不同的治疗是否会康复。只要决策依赖于未观察到的替代方案的结果，此类问题就会出现。回答反事实查询通常需要了解潜在的因果结构，而这在实践中往往是不可得的。因此，一种常见的做法是先从观测数据中估计因果图，然后再进行反事实推断。然而，估计出的因果图中的误差可能会传播到下游的反事实预测中。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了反事实图神经过程（CFGNP），这是一种端到端的方法，可以直接从观测数据回答反事实查询，而无需先估计因果图。CFGNP 利用图神经网络（GNN）来发掘对偶……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出反事实图神经过程（CFGNP），利用图神经网络端到端地直接从观测数据回答反事实查询，无需先估计因果图，从而避免因果图估计误差向下游反事实预测的传播。
en_tdlr: We propose the Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP), an end-to-end approach that leverages GNNs to answer counterfactual queries directly from observational data without estimating a causal graph first, thereby avoiding the propagation of causal graph estimation errors into downstream predictions.
